ideas.title: Investigating Civil Rights Violations by Law Enforcement
ideas.description: This story would investigate the pattern of civil rights violations by law enforcement, including the killing of Alex Pretti and other incidents.
ideas.angle: Follow the Money and Data Analysis
questions: What is the extent of civil rights violations by law enforcement?
What entities are involved in these violations?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale pattern of civil rights violations by law enforcement. By following the money and analyzing data, we may be able to identify the entities involved and the extent of these violations.
